options: I have promised to keep thy words.

Ye shall not observe their judgments.

options: Joseph came from the land of Egypt to bury Jacob.
Now Deborah, a prophetess, was judging Israel at that time, and she used to sit under Deborah's palm in the hill-country of Ephraim.
God said to Abimelech in a dream of the night, Behold, thou art a dead man because of the woman whom thou hast taken, for she is a married woman.
Thine enemies will pursue after thee no more.
items.answer: Thine enemies will pursue after thee no more.
